what: Andrew wants the front-end semantic hash name-free (Unison-style; design docs/v2/plan/design/item-hash.md 3.3/3.7). BoundRegionKind::NamedForPrinting(Symbol), made in lower.rs for_lifetime_region_kind for each for<'a> as written, carries the source lifetime name into types and so into stored inference records, and makes renaming 'a change type equality. Please use rustc's form: Named(def of the lifetime param), with the name fetched only when printing, so stored types carry no names. Found by item-hash-store audit (/tmp/blaze-lanes/v2-item-hash-store.md anon section 2).
